obfuscation_indicators: healthy balance sheet and ample liquidity
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and quantitative, detailing acquisitions, pricing pressure, cash flows, leverage, capital expenditures, and liquidity. Risk is moderated by lower metals pricing, weaker-than-peak construction demand, substantially higher debt, and dependence on continued recovery and acquisition-driven growth. Management uses optimistic forward-looking language that somewhat offsets these acknowledged pressures.
